source_title: UNHCR Global Garden Refugee Training Farm

closed_stage: culturally continuous livelihood autonomy and belonging

missing_stage: comparison group housing school health discrimination work and equal participation
evidence_status: official UNHCR story; qualitative program account

closed_stage: shelter safety local agency and service-navigation route

unit_or_scope: Aguascalientes relocation from southern border refugees including Daysi Cruz Martinez

evidence_status: official UNHCR story; beneficiary account with explicit unresolved barriers
next_test: follow relocated cohort through work quality school access housing and secondary mobility
